notablePrerequisites:
You control an artifact that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate any artifact you control by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Myr Battlesphere from the battlefield to your hand, putting Myr Battlesphere from your hand onto the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping four Myr tokens, untapping the mana-producing artifact and Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
